description: This file defines the OpenmrsClassLoader class, a specialized class loader used within the OpenMRS framework to load classes and resources, manage caching, handle module class loaders, and facilitate module-specific class loading behavior in a modular healthcare application.

classes.name: OpenmrsClassLoader
classes.description: A custom URLClassLoader that loads classes from module class loaders, manages class caching, resource locating, and supports module-specific class loading in the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Overrides the default class loading behavior to first attempt loading from cached classes, then from module class loaders, and finally from the parent class loader.

methods.name: findResource
methods.description: Locates a resource by searching module class loaders first and then the parent class loader, expanding jar URLs for specific use cases.

methods.name: findResources
methods.description: Retrieves all resource URLs matching a name from module class loaders and the parent.

methods.name: getResourceAsStream
methods.description: Searches module class loaders before the parent to get an InputStream for the resource.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Retrieves all resource URLs for a given name from module class loaders and the parent.

methods.name: destroyInstance
methods.description: Destroys the singleton instance, stopping and dereferencing class loader references, facilitating garbage collection.

methods.name: setThreadsToNewClassLoader
methods.description: Adjusts thread context class loaders to reference the new class loader instance.

methods.name: onShutdown
methods.description: Stops all threads referencing the class loader and performs cleanup tasks.

methods.name: clearReferences
methods.description: Ensures cleanup by deregistering JDBC drivers and nulling static fields to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Saves the scheduler service state into a memento before restart.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores the scheduler service state from a memento after restart.

methods.name: flushInstance
methods.description: Reschedules all tasks in the scheduler after reinitialization.

methods.name: getLibCacheFolder
methods.description: Provides the directory for cached library files, creating and cleaning it if necessary.

methods.name: expandURL
methods.description: Expands a jar URL to a file URL in a temporary directory for class/resource loading.
